europe_now.title: Romania Investigates Potential Drone Attack on Tanker
europe_now.summary: Romanian authorities are investigating a possible drone strike involving a tanker near Ukrainian transit routes. The incident highlights escalating security concerns regarding maritime trade in the Black Sea region.

sources.headline: Ukraine live: Romania probes possible drone attack on tanker

europe_now.title: Frontex Suspends Reintegration Program Due to Budget Deficit
europe_now.summary: The European Border and Coast Guard Agency has suspended its reintegration program after depleting its allocated budget. The decision impacts ongoing institutional operations and policy measures regarding border management.

sources.headline: Frontex suspends reintegration program after blowing through its budget

top_stories.title: EU Budget Negotiations and Leadership Dynamics
top_stories.summary: European Union leaders are gathering to debate ongoing budgetary constraints and regional energy challenges. Key political figures face critical decisions regarding future financial allocations and policy reforms.

top_stories.title: Black Sea Security and Maritime Trade Risks
top_stories.summary: Recent maritime incidents and potential drone attacks in NATO waters have heightened risks for regional trade and shipping lanes. Security experts warn that disruptions to grain exports and critical infrastructure pose severe challenges for European stability.
